refresh_minutes.description: How often the CLI is asked for fresh usage. One call serves every capsule.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)

vendor.description: Which plans this capsule tracks, by the id ai-usagebar reports, comma separated for several in one capsule (e.g. "openai,openai@work"). A named account is "<vendor>@<label>".
vendor.label: Vendor

window.description: Which of the plan's windows to read, matched against their names and comma separated for several in one capsule (e.g. "fable,weekly"). Empty takes the first.
window.label: Window
